authority.rule: Same campaign id, world seed, exact place and campaign instant must produce exactly the same environment snapshot. Environment derivation may not write campaign state.

separation_invariants: Static place kind and authored terrain are not transient weather.
Derived environment modifies only registered physical travel, terrain, sensing, tracking, elemental-affordance, economy, or security channels consumed by an exact rules owner.
Derived weather never creates a clue, track, scent identification, detection, technique success, damage, chakra discount, or other campaign fact by itself.
Chakra sensing remains weather-neutral by default; only a separate exact mechanic may change chakra_sensing_milli.
Surface water, conductivity, fire spread and smoke/gas drift are affordance channels. A technique or hazard must explicitly consume the relevant channel before it changes an outcome.
A weather transition does not by itself create a player wake or scheduler event.
Player-safe context exposes current-location environment only unless another read lawfully authorizes a different place.
Narration may describe the derived conditions but may not invent unregistered bonuses, penalties, clues, hidden actors, or technique effects.
